principles: Each task has at most one Primary Tool.
Add a Secondary Tool only when it is required for a concrete next stage.
Do not expand Optional Tools in the startup decision.
If no source, target, or risk clearly selects a tool, default to Native Only.

patterns.reason: Figma is the core input; GitHub is the delivery workflow.
The repository is the real code source; image inspection is needed only if the screenshot is essential.
Drive provides the real source; spreadsheet analysis is required only for structured calculations.
The task is text-only and native capability is enough.
